rationale: Roberts is likely to keep and write the opinion to cabin the holding to genuinely bespoke expressive services and to avoid a broad public-accommodations carveout, a narrowing that also helps retain Kagan and Kavanaugh. Thomas and Alito have strong incentives to concur to press a more categorical compelled-speech rule, while Sotomayor likely authors the principal dissent with Jackson possibly writing separately to emphasize disclaimers/attribution and narrowing the Communication Clause.
